info.title: polhem-db
info.description: Polhem database manager, a dotnet tool invoked as `polhem-db`. Creates, checks and upgrades the databases a Polhem definition folder describes, for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle and SQLite, without an application project.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Open a connection to each database in DatabaseSettings.

commands.name: create
commands.description:
Create the databases named in DatabaseSettings that do not exist, and the
master key file SystemSettings names when it is missing.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description:
Build or upgrade the tables registered in DbCategorySettings.
seed-admin --company <id> [options]
Create the first administrator, a company and the access between them.

options.name: --define
options.description: The definition folder (holds SystemSettings.xml). Default: the current directory.
